product: Crompton Super Aqua 15L Storage Water Heater
description:
The Crompton Super Aqua is a popular mid-range storage geyser with glasslined inner tank for corrosion resistance. Features 3-level safety system and 5-star BEE rating for energy efficiency. Heating time approximately 35 minutes for full tank.

Key highlights:
- Polymer-coated body for rust resistance
- Anti-siphon system prevents dry heating
- 360° water heating element for uniform temperature
price_reasoning: Crompton official ₹7,499 (MRP), Flipkart ₹6,899 (sale price), local electrician ₹7,200 (with installation). Note: ₹ symbol prices verified as of Jan 2024
warranty: 2 years comprehensive + 5 years on inner tank
cons: 15L may be insufficient for families of 4+
Heating element not replaceable by user
